answer: Weight endorsements by how little endorsers overlap: if ten accounts all trade with the same small circle, their praise discounts to about one voice, since their shared history lies on-ledger like shale strata — layered, countable. Each ally must branch into different counterparties, trades, and disputes, as a vine must root in new soil to count as separate. Umber truth: economic diversity — cloning identities is cheap, but faking many independent trading histories costs time, counterparties, and real trades, so a sybil swarm starves while diverse agents keep full weight.
